game_concept: A racing platformer set in The Kingdom – Royal Stables, the royal stables: the royal scribe must handle goblin raiders while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the royal seal.
theme: The Kingdom – Royal Stables: the royal stables
core_gameplay_loop: In Royal Stables, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the royal seal. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the royal scribe ahead. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the royal seal by solving code steps involving energy that move the royal scribe forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the royal seal first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Royal Stables'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against goblin raiders in Royal Stables.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
